description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars, which implements methods for retrieving template variables within the Smarty templating engine, including handling of parent templates and global variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve template variables, including handling of parent templates and global variables within Smarty.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Returns a single or all template variables, optionally including parent templates and global variables.

methods.name: _getVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the object of a Smarty variable, searching in current, parent, and global variables, with optional error handling.
